'''Jared Aydaer''' was a resident of the [[Two Rivers]]. 

== Activities ==
When [[Perrin Aybara]] sets up an ambush for a group of [[Trollocs]] in the Two Rivers, they are betrayed by Lord Luc ([[Slayer]]) and Jared is killed when the Trollocs then ambush Perrin's group.{{ref/book|4|40}}
